summary.intent: Prepare the already-implemented phase 43 (FUSE write durability) branch for shipping by integrating the newly merged phase 42 main into it and getting it into a PR-ready state.
summary.outcome: Branch successfully integrated with main: all phase-42 merge conflicts resolved, stray artifacts removed, and the diff reduced to exactly the 17 phase-43 source files. Four runtime UAT checks remain pending before the PR can be opened.

repo: Phase 43 source files (fuse/sdk/desktop/Cargo.lock) are fully disjoint from phase 42 files (API/web), making conflict resolution straightforward: all phase-42 conflicts resolve to main's version.
The web vitest config skips `.spec.ts` files; canonical test files use `.test.ts`. A leftover `delete.service.spec.ts` (pre-squash draft) survived on the branch and would never have run.

release-please-config.json is not in .prettierignore and prettier prefers inline array format; main's expanded multi-line format is actually a prettier violation that slipped through, making the cosmetic diff unavoidable.
Phase 43 had 8 code review criticals (CR-01..CR-08) that were all closed by gap-closure plans 43-05..08; round-2 verification confirmed 18/18 must-haves, zero gaps, zero regressions.
Two new deferred todos were added during phase 42: encrypt-share-itemname-at-rest and ipns-signature-storage-review.
workflow: When a feature branch predates a squash merge on main, merge main into the branch (don't rebase) to avoid re-litigating the squashed commits in the PR diff.
lint-staged with prettier can reject deletion-only commits as 'empty' due to a quirk in how staged deletions interact with the hook pipeline.
Husky/lint-staged hooks can silently reformat files during conflict resolution, reverting explicit git checkouts — verify file state after each resolve step.

friction: Branch predated the phase-42 squash merge, requiring a full merge-main-in pass before the branch was PR-able; a naive PR would have tried to revert phase 42.
Transient file lock on delete.service.ts interrupted the batch conflict resolution, requiring a retry.
release-please-config.json: prettier reformatted it back to inline during the husky hook, reverting the explicit reset to main's expanded version — the cosmetic diff vs main is now permanent.
Cleanup commit initially rejected as 'empty' by lint-staged when only a file deletion was staged.
open_items: 4 runtime UAT items pending (require live desktop + mounted vault): journal survival after SIGKILL, park notification render with OS notification, mkdir orphan survival across restart, and ciphertext-only journal verification.
Push branch and open PR — deferred until UAT passes.
release-please-config.json has a minor cosmetic line-format difference vs main (inline vs expanded array); flagged as unavoidable but worth noting for reviewers.

New deferred todo: IPNS signature storage review (2026-06-13-ipns-signature-storage-review-deferred.md).
